candidates.description: This vector represents forms of the verb "to be" across multiple languages, including English and Thai.
This vector activates for fragment tokens from a multilingual text corpus containing Thai script and mixed Latin characters.
This vector represents Thai consonant characters, linguistic subword units, and vowel-consonant combinations used in Thai text processing.
This vector represents Thai words, syllables, or character combinations ending with the consonant ก (ko kai).
This vector activates for common suffixes and short grammatical particles across multiple languages.
This vector represents common adjectival and nominal suffixes across various languages.
This vector represents conjunctions and connective words in Thai and English.
This feature vector activates on common prefixes, subwords, and morphemes across multiple natural languages.
This vector represents multilingual text processing, specifically involving Thai script and linguistic or translation terminology.
This feature vector represents a multilingual mixture of unrelated words and characters lacking a cohesive semantic theme.
